records.name: Balmoral Castle
records.description: Royal Highland residence set in extensive estate grounds and one of the great icons of Royal Deeside.

records.name: Royal Lochnagar Distillery
records.description: Small royal-deeside distillery opposite Balmoral, known for classic Highland whisky tours.

records.name: Crathes Castle
records.description: Turreted National Trust castle with painted ceilings, gardens and a classic Castle Trail setting.

records.name: Castle Fraser
records.description: One of Scotland's grand tower houses, surrounded by woodland walks and estate landscapes.

records.name: Craigievar Castle
records.description: Pink fairytale tower house often cited as one of the most photogenic castles in Scotland.

records.name: Drum Castle
records.description: Ancient tower, later mansion wings and formal gardens together make this a Castle Trail staple.

records.name: Haddo House
records.description: Elegant stately home with fine interiors and surrounding parkland in northern Aberdeenshire.

records.name: Leith Hall
records.description: Country house with gardens and estate views reflecting generations of Banffshire and Aberdeenshire history.

records.name: Fyvie Castle
records.description: Famous for lavish interiors, legends and one of northeast Scotland's finest great-house settings.

records.name: Tolquhon Castle
records.description: Highly atmospheric courtyard castle ruin with striking Renaissance detail.

records.name: Kildrummy Castle
records.description: Dramatic ruin of a major medieval fortress once central to the Wars of Independence.

records.name: Corgarff Castle
records.description: Remote white-walled barracks-castle with superb mountain surroundings on the Lecht road.

records.name: Delgatie Castle
records.description: Privately run historic castle noted for Jacobite links and colourful domestic interiors.

records.name: Slains Castle
records.description: Romantic clifftop ruins often linked with the landscapes that inspired Gothic fiction.

records.name: Dunnottar Castle
records.description: Spectacular sea-girt fortress on a rock headland, one of Scotland's most dramatic castle sites.

records.name: Pitmedden Garden
records.description: Formal walled garden and house complex famed for colourful geometric planting.

records.name: Glen Garioch Distillery
records.description: Historic Highland distillery and a favourite stop for whisky-focused trips from Aberdeen.

records.name: Macduff Marine Aquarium
records.description: Family-friendly aquarium highlighting Moray Firth marine life, tides and coastal ecosystems.

records.name: Duff House
records.description: Grand Georgian house and art venue that anchors Banff's architectural heritage.

records.name: Museum of Scottish Lighthouses
records.description: Maritime museum set at Kinnaird Head telling the story of Scotland's lighthouse engineers and keepers.

records.name: Kinnaird Head Castle
records.description: Rare castle-lighthouse conversion overlooking Fraserburgh's seaward edge.

records.name: Aden Country Park
records.description: Large country park with woodland, heritage buildings and open space in central Buchan.

records.name: Bennachie
records.description: Much-loved hill range visible from far across the northeast and rich in local legend.

records.name: Mither Tap
records.description: Iconic summit tor atop Bennachie with an Iron Age fort and sweeping 360-degree views.

records.name: Forvie National Nature Reserve
records.description: Huge dune system, bird habitat and coastal wilderness at the Ythan estuary.

records.name: Bullers of Buchan
records.description: Collapsed sea cave forming a dramatic cliff-ringed chasm on the Buchan coast.

records.name: Newburgh Seal Beach
records.description: Sandy Ythan estuary shore famed for its large resident seal colony.

records.name: RSPB Fowlsheugh
records.description: Sheer coastal cliffs crowded with seabirds in the nesting season and great cliff-top walks.

records.name: Loch Muick
records.description: Beautiful Highland loch ringed by hills and one of Royal Deeside's classic walking destinations.

records.name: Mar Lodge Estate
records.description: Vast Cairngorms estate of native woodland, red deer country and big-mountain scenery.

records.name: Linn of Dee
records.description: Rocky river gorge and popular gateway to some of the grandest walks in the southern Cairngorms.

records.name: Braemar Castle
records.description: Compact white-harled castle that introduces visitors to upper Deeside history and clan stories.

records.name: Braemar Highland Games Centre
records.description: Home of the famous Braemar Gathering, long associated with Highland games and royal attendance.
records.address: Princess Royal and Duke of Fife Memorial Park, Braemar

records.name: Portsoy Harbour
records.description: Historic 17th-century harbour framed by traditional buildings and a strong coastal character.

records.name: Pennan
records.description: Tiny fishing village tucked beneath steep cliffs and celebrated for its postcard setting.

records.name: Gardenstown
records.description: Steeply terraced coastal village with a sheltered harbour and remarkable sea views.

records.name: Fraserburgh Heritage Centre
records.description: Local heritage centre introducing Fraserburgh's fishing, lighthouse and maritime traditions.

records.name: Deer Abbey
records.description: Atmospheric monastic ruin linked to the medieval Book of Deer and the religious history of Buchan.

records.name: Haddo Country Park
records.description: Expansive parkland, lakes and woodland walks complementing a visit to Haddo House.

records.name: Prince Albert Cairn
records.description: Prominent pyramid cairn raised by Queen Victoria in memory of Prince Albert above Balmoral.
